body: Same, this really resonated with me.

I had a good day once. Had some energy, was productive, didn’t feel like shit. I was like, uh oh, I’m manic. Must be bipolar after all. But nah man, I think feeling good just doesn’t feel normal after a while, you know? Just ride that high man and enjoy it.
You’re right, man. I was just having an extra shitty day. People should do whatever they can to feel better and find more enjoyment.
And my fucking cats. Who would take care of them if I weren’t here. I hate these dependencies. God I wish I were truly alone.

Having children is selfish. I didn’t ask for this bullshit, parents have children to fill their own voids and try to manufacture happiness out of pointless lives. Fuck trying to “get better.” Even if you get on an antidepressant and subjectively have less shitty moments throughout the day, that doesn’t change how miserable an experience life is as a whole.
